input.quote: The parties agree that all drawings, documents, designs, models, inventions, computer programs, computer systems, data, computer documentation and other tangible materials authored or prepared by Contractor for Company as the work product required by a Statement of Work (collectively, the "Works"), are the property of Company
input.rationale: Section 4 vests the Works (deliverables under each Statement of Work) in us as Company, with Contractor obliged to give assistance and execute documents to perfect our rights (p0017-p0018). Contractor's retention of its own pre-existing tools, methodologies and know-how (p0020) is expressly paired with a royalty-free, non-exclusive, perpetual, sublicensable licence to use, copy, modify and create derivatives of any Contractor's Information embedded in the Works for our business operations (p0021), and p0022 confirms we may modify the software ourselves or through third parties without further payment. There is no assignment of Clear Capital IP or data to Contractor, no joint ownership, and our data remains protected as Confidential Information (p0038); the Contractor's warranty at p0025 carves out programs, data and materials provided by us. This meets the preferred position on the material terms. Two minor gaps worth noting but not redlining: the licence back is not stated to be "irrevocable" or "worldwide", and deliverable ownership attaches only to periods for which an invoice "has been paid" rather than paid or payable; we can raise either as clean-up if the document is otherwise being amended.
